about: Formations this fish may swim in. sizes = school size limits; lag and lat = spacing behind and beside, in body lengths and heights.

arc.what: Side by side in a shallow arc; the middle fish leads.

echelon.what: A diagonal step line, each fish behind and beside the one ahead.

line.what: Single file, nose to tail along the route.

ball.what: A tight round cluster that moves as one.
